hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom AMM backed by Euler Finance lending vaults. All swap logic runs in beforeSwap: it computes quotes via a custom pricing curve (CurveLib), deposits input tokens into an Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from another, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to bypass standard concentrated-liquidity pool math entirely.
